tw.name: 蛻變石
effects: 將一件普通物品升級成帶有 1 條詞綴的魔法物品
instructions:
右鍵點擊此物品，再左鍵點擊一件普通物品來使用。
按住 Shift 點擊以分開堆疊

en.name: Orb of Transmutation
effects: Upgrades a Normal item to a Magic item with 1 modifier
instructions:
Right click this item then left click a normal item to apply it.
Shift click to unstack.

tw.name: 增幅石
effects: 強化魔法物品，加入一個新的隨機詞綴
instructions:
右鍵點擊此物品，再左鍵點擊一件魔法物品使用。魔法裝備最多可以擁有兩個屬性。
按住 Shift 點擊以分開堆疊

en.name: Orb of Augmentation
effects: Augments a Magic item with a new random modifier
instructions:
Right click this item then left click a magic item to apply it. Magic items can have up to two random modifiers.
Shift click to unstack.

tw.name: 富豪石
effects: 將一件魔法物品升級成稀有物品，並新增 1 條詞綴
instructions:
右鍵點擊此物品，再左鍵點擊一件魔法物品使用。此物品上原有的屬性會保留並額外再增加一個屬性。
按住 Shift 點擊以分開堆疊

en.name: Regal Orb
effects: Upgrades a Magic item to a Rare item, adding 1 modifier
instructions:
Right click this item then left click a magic item to apply it. Current modifiers are retained and a new one is added.
Shift click to unstack.

tw.name: 崇高石
